capabilities: Highlight words from custom .json wordbooks in notes and PDFs
Look up words locally or with AI and save definitions to wordbooks
Review vocabulary in a flashcard Study Center with a simplified SM-2 algorithm
Browse, filter, and batch-edit all words in a library table
Import and export wordbooks as Markdown, Anki TSV, or TXT lists
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff. README states it is developed with AI assistance. Debug logs may contain note content and AI responses and the README warns not to share them publicly.
problem: Reading in Obsidian offers no built-in way to mark unknown words, look them up, and study them as vocabulary over time.

relations.evidence: Anki-compatible TXT (TSV): tab-separated, ready to import into Anki.

requires.name: AI provider API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, GLM, Tongyi Qianwen, Ollama, or custom)
Anki (only for importing exported TSV files)

summary: Vocabulary learning plugin that highlights words from custom wordbooks in notes and PDFs, with AI lookup, spaced-repetition review, and TTS.
